Intentional mid-edit / ambiguity fixture (does not fully compile).

`consumer::run` deliberately names:
- `text_facade::get` — rustc E0659 (two glob re-exports)
- `text_facade::crate_only_version` — rustc E0603 (`pub(crate)` only)
- `text_facade::private_mod::from_private` — rustc E0603 (private module)
- `format_engine::upper` — rustc E0433 (undeclared dependency)

The successful facade forms (`upper`, `split`, `chained`, `area`, `from_private`)
are valid Rust; the crate as a whole is kept non-compiling so the negative
cases stay in source for the oracle harness.
